description: Capabilities granted to the main window of Simple Post. The custom `http_request` command does not need an explicit permission entry — Tauri 2 allows invoke-handler-registered commands by default. `fs` is granted per-verb and scoped to `$HOME/**/*` rather than via `fs:default`, which would open read and write over the whole user directory; export only writes one text file to a path the user just picked in the save dialog.
